overview.about: The Six Nations is the northern hemisphere's premier international rugby union championship, contested each year by England, France, Ireland, Italy, Scotland and Wales. A round-robin over five weekends, it carries traditions like the Grand Slam, the Triple Crown and the Calcutta Cup, and packs out stadiums across Europe.
overview.nextEvent: The next Six Nations runs from February into March, with each nation playing the other five home or away over five rounds. A team winning all five games claims the Grand Slam; the Championship is one of rugby's oldest and best-loved.
